description.en-US: More's letter of 1533 against John Frith's denial of the Real Presence and of purgatory.
description.pt-BR: A carta de More (1533) contra a negação da Presença Real e do purgatório por John Frith.

sources.edition: A letter of syr Tho. More knyght impugnynge the erronyouse writyng of Johan Fryth, EEBO-TCP A07704.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 22 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1533 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
